ng-add.description: Install the domain package schematics: the workspace config, Sheriff, the root scripts and editor settings.

domain.description: A domain package with its layers, configs and wiring.

layer.description: A layer in an existing domain.

testing.description: The domain's testing entry point for test doubles, which only spec files may import.

feature-component.description: A smart component in feature/<noun>/; --routed or --slot makes it a lazy sub-module.

ui-component.description: A presentational component in ui/<noun>/: input() and output() only.

store.description: A global or component signalStore in data/<noun>/.

slot.description: A multi-provider token and its provideX() in ui/<noun>/.

worker.description: A web worker in data/<noun>/, the function that starts it, its tsconfig and Sheriff entry point.

uses.description: Adds a domain to another's uses line, after checking it makes no cycle.

move.description: Moves files or symbols to another layer, domain or package and rewrites every import.

extract-domain.description: Moves an app folder into a new domain package.

publishable.description: Makes a domain or library publishable through git-flow's ng-lib or npm artifact.
